Triage: **`needs-user-decision`** (kept `domain:devx`, applied by os-help 02:26Z — landing agrees: the change is prose in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, general agent tooling per the #5469 criterion, not spec-contract tooling).

Why the decision box and not the queue: the SKILL's Operational notes are binding fleet process, and the card itself leaves the wording to the maintainer and offers a higher evidence bar ("mechanism rather than the symptom") the maintainer may want before amending — that acceptance call is not a dev's to make. The proposal is well-evidenced (6/6 `added_to_merge_queue` timeline readings across #7333/#7346/#7389/#7400/#7449/#7471, plus the measured ~1s `removed_from_merge_queue`→`merged` success-sequence distinction), so once ruled, the edit itself is mechanical.

**Premise check** (`origin/main` @ `8dd98bf`): Operational note 1 still prescribes the `gh-readonly-queue/*` branch listing as the membership criterion with 「没有匹配分支才是真的没入队」 verbatim, and no note currently distinguishes the success-sequence from a real ejection (grep for `added_to_merge_queue` in SKILL.md: zero hits — the proposed criterion is genuinely absent). The card's scope note (#5810 queue-steward alignment in the same pass) checks out as the right coupling.

**Dup check:** no open card proposes amending note 1's membership criterion (probes: gh-readonly-queue / added_to_merge_queue / merge queue criterion over open issues + PRs; #7369 is the flaky-ejection neighbour the card already distinguishes). Sibling card #7493 (filed one minute later) amends a different SKILL section — kept separate, no convergence needed.

Not `target:v17` — internal process tooling, none of the four blocking classes.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

**Two data points from the identity lane, 2026-08-11 (session `session_01JKdeE2CjKviipthNQmZ7Ub`), for whoever grades this card** — they bear on the pm-dispatch SKILL's Operational note 21 (the empty-field auto-merge signature), which is adjacent to the note-1 amendment this card proposes:

1. **The empty-field `enable_pr_auto_merge` return (`method: , enabled at `) on an all-green PR is not a reliable "armed-but-not-enqueued" indicator.** Both PRs this shift (#7506, #7508) were all-green/`clean` at enable time, both calls returned the empty-field form, and both PRs were **enqueued anyway** — confirmed by the `added_to_merge_queue` webhook and a positive `gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-N-*` branch hit, and both merged first pass. Note 21's three prior cases (#6034/#6092/#6197) saw the same signature with NO enqueue. So the signature alone distinguishes nothing; only the queue readings do — which is this card's own thesis, extended to note 21.
2. **`disable_pr_auto_merge` did not dequeue a queued PR** (#7506: disable issued at ~04:34Z as step one of the note-21 flip, after the enqueue had already happened; the PR stayed in the queue and merged normally). Consistent with the Guardrails note that only a draft conversion removes queue membership — now with a same-day measurement.

Suggested disposition if this card is accepted: fold note 21's prescription into the amended note 1 as "read membership from the timeline event / a positive queue-branch hit; treat the enable-call's return shape as noise; flip only when membership is genuinely absent."

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

Maintainer ruling recorded 2026-08-11 (PM session, executing the maintainer's direct instruction in chat — verbatim: 「接受你的全部建议，请更新 issue 的状态和标签」, accepting the four-lens decision-inbox review in full).

**Ruling: accepted.** Operational note 1 is amended: (1) queue-membership criterion becomes the `added_to_merge_queue` timeline event (6/6 this tenure; the `gh-readonly-queue/*` branch test is sufficient-but-not-necessary — at queue capacity it gives a false negative); (2) add the success-sequence rule: `removed_from_merge_queue` followed by `merged` within ~1s is a **landing**, not an ejection — a real ejection has no `merged` after it and the PR stays open. The `auto_merge`-field half of note 1 stands unchanged.

State: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (`domain:devx` seat, consolidated SKILL batch, `model: claude-fable-5`).

Third data point from the identity seat (session `session_01BVc1ekPpi6yaWywAUhfzfd`), PR #7605, 2026-08-11:

- `enable_pr_auto_merge` on an all-green, just-un-drafted PR returned the **empty-field signature** (`method: , enabled at `) — and the PR **enqueued normally**: `added_to_merge_queue` webhook received within seconds, merged at 08:13Z without any disable/enable flip.
- Queue-branch reading taken between arming and merge showed only the PR ahead in line (`pr-7558-…`), no branch yet for #7605 — consistent with the build-chain lag noted here; the timeline event was the reliable positive reading.

Running tally for the empty-field signature on all-green PRs: **3/3 enqueued fine** (2 from the previous identity shift, this one). Supports the proposed amendment direction: verify by queue readings, flip only on genuine non-enqueue. Ungraded — no skill edit implied by this comment.
